title: FEWS NET retail market prices + MoALD KAMIS live-animal monthly medians, Kenya
source: FEWS NET Data Warehouse (FDW), marketpricefacts (source LIKE 'FEWS NET FDW%') UNION MoALD KAMIS kamis.kilimo.go.ke (source LIKE 'MoALD KAMIS%')
citation: FEWS NET Data Warehouse (FDW). Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock Development (MoALD), Kenya: KAMIS livestock market prices.
license: Mixed providers via FDW and MoALD KAMIS. Public API access is not blanket redistribution permission. See provider-level lineage and governance/redistribution_register.json. Preserve existing external-use restrictions; the reviewed FEWS-origin extract is separate.
method: _sources/fews_prices_build.py validates the complete official Kenya CSV, retains the existing 12-product, positive KES, county-mapped monthly scope, and preserves KAMIS rows. Identical panel rows collapse; multiple observations with different prices remain distinct. _sources/fdw_market_prices_lineage.parquet retains the original observation IDs, provider source_document, status and usage policy, joined on all panel fields except n_quotes. _sources/fews_prices_refresh.json records input/output hashes, exclusions and revisions. KAMIS rows are monthly medians of clean wholesale per-head quotes. Terms of trade is derived in the notebook from the FDW goat and maize retail legs.
coverage: FEWS NET: county x market x product monthly prices (KES), retail + wholesale, 42 counties, 2000-2026. KAMIS: county x market x species monthly medians (KES/head, wholesale), 45 counties, 2021-2026 (camels to 2025-11).
used_by: notebook §4.4 market prices + derived terms of trade (FEWS NET rows; the KAMIS rows are Wholesale and not yet selected by the Figure 4.4 Retail filter)
